core_obligations: The author constructs bounded-error unitary algorithms from approximate span programs using witness scaling and spectral analysis, and converts arbitrary bounded-error unitary algorithms to approximate span programs with size exponential in space and complexity linear in query count. The exact K/C/S/T tradeoffs and one-sided-error clause are retained. This is one bidirectional construction family; logarithmic-space lower bounds and almost-all counting consequences are not separately counted.
